commands.notes: Legal only when phase === null (unstarted); a re-start throws RunAlreadyExistsError. Net effect null -> DISCOVERY: prepare authors run.started + the phase.changed anchor (SCENARIO -> SCENARIO) from buildRunStartedEvents, and the startRun use case then bundles the auto-accept phase.changed (SCENARIO -> DISCOVERY, commandId `${commandId}:accept`).

Auto-issued inside startRun and prepareRetry; there is NO standalone learner CLI command. The plan text described accept as 'SCENARIO -> SCENARIO anchor', but the SCENARIO -> SCENARIO anchor is authored by buildRunStartedEvents (the start command); accept's own phase.changed is SCENARIO -> DISCOVERY.

No phase change (stays DISCOVERY). Success batch: question.asked, customer.replied, evidence.patched, question.assessed. On Evidence Tracker failure the batch is question.asked, customer.replied, evidence.pending (reply retained, frame blocked until repair).
No phase change. Legal in DISCOVERY and PROBLEM_FRAMING only.
On gate PASS also appends phase.changed (PROBLEM_FRAMING -> SOLUTION_DESIGN); on FAIL it stays PROBLEM_FRAMING with no phase.changed (brief.validated passed=false).
Consumes one unit of the clarification budget (default DEFAULT_CLARIFICATION_BUDGET=3); throws CLARIFICATION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED when exhausted.

Emits design.submitted + phase.changed (SOLUTION_DESIGN -> CHALLENGE). The submitDesign use case then bundles the deterministic challenge injection (challenge.injected + customer.replied per selected candidate), which does NOT change phase.
Appends phase.changed (CHALLENGE -> PITCH) only when every mandatory challenge id has a recorded response; otherwise stays CHALLENGE (no phase.changed).
No phase change: review does NOT advance REVIEW -> COMPLETED and does NOT emit run.completed. Also folds a profile.apply-attempt command effect.

Parent run stays REVIEW (retry.started is the only parent event; no parent phase.changed). A retry.ensure-child effect spawns a NEW child run at DISCOVERY whose events are run.started, retry.focus, phase.changed (SCENARIO -> SCENARIO), phase.changed (SCENARIO -> DISCOVERY).

Declared in the RunCommand union and assertCommandPhase (requires RETRY_READY) but UNWIRED: no use case, orchestrator prepare, or CLI command references it. No code path sets phase to RETRY_READY either, so RETRY_READY is currently unreachable.

Declared but UNWIRED: no use case, orchestrator prepare, or CLI command. Would emit run.completed (REVIEW -> COMPLETED) per domain, but no code path does so; COMPLETED is currently unreachable (review stays in REVIEW).

Legal in ACTIVE_PHASES (all phases except COMPLETED, ABORTED, and the unstarted null state) but UNWIRED: no use case, orchestrator prepare, or CLI command. Would emit run.aborted (-> ABORTED) per domain; ABORTED is currently unreachable.

feedbackLoops.name: discovery
feedbackLoops.description: The learner asks many questions inside DISCOVERY; ask does not change phase, so DISCOVERY is a self-loop until the learner commits to framing.

feedbackLoops.name: problem-framing
feedbackLoops.description: The learner iterates on the brief: clarify returns PROBLEM_FRAMING -> DISCOVERY for more questions, frame re-enters PROBLEM_FRAMING, and a rejected submit-brief stays in PROBLEM_FRAMING for revision. Only a passing brief exits.

feedbackLoops.name: challenge
feedbackLoops.description: The learner addresses injected challenges: each respond-challenge records a response; the run stays in CHALLENGE until every mandatory injected challenge has a response, at which point it advances to PITCH.
